metadata.description:
Towering with neo-Gothic flair, the Wells Fargo Center is what happens when a bank wants a cathedral. Designed by César Pelli, its limestone exterior and elegant setbacks nod to a more classical era—even though it was built in the '80s. It’s both fortress and beacon, anchoring downtown with quiet confidence. Add this Architecture Aficionado POAP to your collection in the 612 POAP Challenge and celebrate timeless ambition. 

Category: Architecture Aficionado 
GPS: 44.97697, -93.27088 
Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/44.97697,-93.27088
